items.note: S2.1.1 says a fixed linear network exchanges two banks with signs and restores auxiliary values, but gives no h=100, triples, gate schedule or the map (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a).

S2.1.2 says intermediate frames cancel and a route applies an endpoint operator, but omits the commutation of a common frame with a pointwise gate and the formula D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}. This is borderline with stated; I chose the conservative verdict.
S2.1.3 names nested subspaces of an m-dimensional space built from three-element subsets. It gives no decreasing edges, no loss h, no L=Ich and no budget Wm-2N+2L.
Only 'an endpoint operator such as an address shear' and s<Wm appear. The projection matrices, the identity M_sink-M_source=I_m and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b are missing.
No step concerns phase frames C_U, translation kernels or s_c. S2.2 only cites the layer proposition.
The plan states s<Wm and s/W<m giving tau<1. It omits why (L<N/2), the deficits eta and the value tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}.
S2.1.1 mentions distributing rows cyclically among W roles, one of the elementary operations, with no linear-cost claim. Controlled shifts are not mentioned.

It states the factorization E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones and that a rank-a shear needs a interchanges. It drops the invertibility of the triangular factors and the O(V) further work over Z/q^b, and gives no derivation.

S2.1.6 states the O(Ve^tau) bound but omits the row-field divisibility by W^k. The S2.1 method (network, frames, recursion on V/W, edges as smaller interchanges) follows the paper's route. Missing are the explicit recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the completion of the shear H<-H+D into an interchange, and the O(V) fixed-tape schedule.
S2.1 states the O(Vu^tau) bound for u-bit fields correctly. No step shows the extension from power widths (row-field padding, base-m pieces, padding to [q^e]).
No step treats conjugation by P_M, child C-tensor calls or the H_0=bSCS recovery.
No step concerns packed selected-bit XORs or bad-set repair.
S2's method ('obtain both procedures from fixed linear networks with a strict rank saving and recurse') alludes to it. No recurrence F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) is given.
S2.2 states H_0 at the same bit in at most d chunks, cost O(Vd^{lambda'}) and error below sqrt2 2^{-p}, which matches the proposition. There is no derivation and no account of guard bits.
Character cancellation F_t^+F_t^-=t^{-1}I is stated correctly. The layout result says only 'at the stated cost', without LBF^-, the error or the cost formula.
It states exact products by signed packing with the established O(n log n) multiplier in O(rp log(rp)). It omits B_0=2^{4p} and the normalized truncated output Q_p(fg/r).

The construction (two forward transforms, pointwise products, opposite transform on the retained layout) is right. The normalization by rM, the error and cost bounds, and the reason the LB order is harmless are missing.

S4.1 describes expressing prime-length transforms through power-of-two transforms by contractions with retained permutations. It gives no identity P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA and no condition on theta.
Bluestein's turning of the middle transform into a convolution is named without the chirp formula. The cancellation of the source permutation R is absent.
Only kappa=2^{-182} and the words 'fixed rational parameters', p, d, r appear. There are no sizes, no prime lengths and no other exponent values.
S5 says a Chinese-remainder map preserving convolution places digits on prime axes. It gives no formula for Phi and no triangular digit map.
The twist and the wrap compensation are described in words. There is no x_d->zeta y with zeta=e^{pi i/r} and no M_C formula.

S7 lists the sequence of operations (digits, address map, three transforms, scalings, rounding, carries). The source transform's exact counterpart 2^gamma B_0 Q F_t A=RF_s and the specific scalings by S and 2^{2b+4}S are absent.
It states error below 1/2, then rounding and carries. The error chain, the bound 448b 2^{-b+gamma} and the roles of p=6b and gamma<=b/4 are missing.
It correctly says each table term is at most p^{1-2kappa} and gives the final bound. The table entries, the margins with min g_2=2kappa and the absorption of log powers by p^kappa are not given.
Only the 'relies on: nlogn-conjecture' tag in S0 and the motivation touch it. The liminf negation argument is absent.

errors.says: Prime-length transforms reduce to power-of-two d-axis transforms 'followed by' a normalized cyclic convolution.
errors.paper: The middle power-of-two transform QF_t is itself converted by the chirp identity into a convolution, between the Gaussian maps A and B_0. It is not a transform followed by a convolution.

errors.says: Two disjoint contiguous chunks of e=m^k digits can be interchanged in O(Ve^tau), stated unconditionally.
errors.paper: The proposition requires a row field preceding both chunks with length divisible by W^k, radix-q digits for a suitable prime q, and s/W<m^tau.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route at the level of its introduction: two fast tape procedures from linear networks, synthetic transforms, resampling, chirp, CRT, twist, recovery and the time count. It reaches the main bound only by quoting the conclusions. It thins out in the network argument, which gives no label budget, no L<N/2, no endpoint identity and no explicit recurrence or tau value. The butterfly layer S2.2 is a bare citation of the proposition, with no phase-frame recursion, packed additions or layer recurrence.

steps.note: It names a fixed network exchanging banks with signs and restoring auxiliary values. It has no h=100, no triple indexing, no N or m, and no map (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a).
It says frames cancel and leave an endpoint operator. It omits the commutation with pointwise gates, the formula D_out S D_in^{-1} and the per-edge cost as a frame change.
Nested subspaces of an m-dimensional space from three-element subsets are named. There is no F^{otimes 3}, no decreasing central edges and no loss h.
No step says that rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U or that source edges have rank one. S2.1.3 only links subspaces to a count s without the mechanism.
No budget Wm-2N+2L and no s_b formula appear.
s<Wm is asserted, but there is no L/N=100/539 or 101/539 and no deficit N-2L>0.
'an endpoint operator such as an address shear' alludes to it. There is no M_sink-M_source=I_m and no statement that the same shear H<-H+D acts on every role.

S2.1.5 gives A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones and a interchanges per rank-a shear. S2.1 and S2.1.4 turn edges into smaller interchanges, s calls per node. The O(V) side work is omitted, which I treat as a minor omission.

It has calls on volume V/W, the factor s/W<m and the resulting O(Vu^tau), tau<1. The recurrence formula, the condition s/W<m^tau and the value tau=1-2^{-50} with its eta argument are missing, so I did not count it as reconstructed.

central.summary: The plan carries the shape of the central saving as the paper's introduction states it (network, frames, nested subspaces, s<Wm, factor s/W<m), but only C8 has its defining content. The quantitative core is absent: rank equals dimension change, the budget Wm-2N+2L, L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity and tau=1-2^{-50}.
